title: Authorize and serialize shipment milestone registration against live reference evidence
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Use current enabled identity and existing source-module menu/customer scope via ERP362 shipment-reference authorization for list/detail/parent candidates/create/void, before counts or evidence reads. Scope against exact persisted parent source id/type, never free-text match. No new milestone permission or grants. Preserve authorized historical milestone reads with explicit unavailable parent/source annotation; deny new evidence on voided/deleted/cancelled parent source.

Serialize parent/source eligibility and same parent/type/time active uniqueness in the compatible ERP362 source/reference row lock transaction. Two simultaneous registrations yield exactly one effective event; parent void racing registration yields only a consistent serialized result. Serialize milestone void on its row, preserve original event/time/source/actor and required reason, reject repeat void, allow new event after explicit void. Failure rolls back entirely and changes no upstream/stock/finance. Test actual service/controllers with SQL duplicate registration, parent void race, restricted ownership, revoked permission and preserved historical evidence.
